entities.name: Santa Maria Maggiore, Lomello
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Maria Maggiore is a church in Lomello, province of Pavia, Lombardy, Italy, an example of First Romanesque art. It includes the oldest cross vaults in Italy.
